en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Yasser Al Khadim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The generous one eats the food of the people so that they would be eating from his food; and the stingy one does not eat from the food of the people so that perhaps they might eat from his food’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Yasar al-Khadim who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan al-Rida, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
A generous person eats people’s food so that they eat his food. A stingy person does not eat people’s food so that they will not eat his food.’”
